scenes.line1: Which UI test tool fits your project?
scenes.say: Picking the right UI automation tool can make or break your test suite. Do you know how Playwright, Selenium, and Cypress compare?

scenes.label: Playwright
scenes.sub: Modern, auto-waiting, runs tests in parallel easily.
scenes.say: Playwright is modern, handles auto-waiting for you, and runs tests in parallel with little setup.

scenes.label: Selenium
scenes.sub: Mature, supports many languages and browsers.
scenes.say: Selenium is the veteran. It works with many languages and browsers, but needs manual waits for elements.

scenes.label: Cypress
scenes.say: Cypress is fast and JavaScript-focused, but mostly supports Chrome-family browsers.
Playwright gives you auto-waiting and easy parallelization. Selenium offers flexibility with languages and browsers, but you handle waits yourself.

scenes.question: How does Playwright handle waiting?
scenes.right: Playwright auto-waits for elements to be ready, reducing test flakiness.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap: Playwright auto-waits for elements, so you rarely need manual waits.
